name: Dependency Security Audit (npm)
description: Write an npm audit report for a project on a schedule, so known vulnerabilities in dependencies surface on a regular cadence rather than only when someone happens to run the command by hand.

parameters.label: Project path
parameters.help: Folder containing package.json (avoid spaces in the path).

parameters.label: Report file path
parameters.help: Where to write the audit report. Note: npm audit exits non-zero when vulnerabilities are found, so the run shows as failed exactly when there is something to review.
